name: Infinite Scatter Gallery
description: Full-screen infinitely looping vertical gallery of staggered images with parallax scrolling. Clicking an image morphs it into a large preview with a character-by-character title and description.
contents: Vertical column of images with captions, each offset horizontally and sized individually
Detail overlay with enlarged image, back button, title and description
behavior: Wheel and touch input drives a seamless infinite vertical loop with eased scrubbing
Each slide moves at its own parallax speed
Slides and caption characters fade in as they enter the viewport
Click or Enter opens an image into a full-height preview with a morph transition and staggered text reveal
Escape or the back button reverses the morph
Loop is rebuilt on window resize
On screens below 768px the preview shrinks to the top and text sits below it
editableByProps: Images, captions, titles, descriptions, horizontal offsets and widths
Spacing, aspect ratio, parallax speeds, scroll sensitivity and all transition timings and eases

needsCodeEdit.where: The fixed contentRef div containing the previewRef figure and text groups

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the fade-in of slides entering the viewport
Change the fade of other slides during the open transition

fixed: Takes over page scrolling: wheel and touch input is captured on the window with preventDefault, so the page itself does not scroll
Adds a document keydown listener for Escape and a window resize listener, both removed on unmount
Root is a full-screen overflow-hidden section
Detail overlay is fixed over the whole viewport
Items need at least a few entries for the infinite loop to look right
